senses.gloss:
खिल खिल, अस्, अम्, m. n. a piece of waste
or uncultivated land situated between cultivated fields,
a desert, bare soil, a vacant space, a space not filled
up, a gap, that which serves to fill up a gap, a sup-
plement (of a book &c.), an additional hymn appended
to the regular collection; a compendium, a compi-
lation (especially of hymns and prayers); remainder;
emptiness, vacuity, vanity, anything vain, empty or
fruitless; (अस्), m., N. of Brahmā, and of Viṣṇu.
खील खील, अस्, m., Ved. = कील, q. v.

खिली-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -वितुम्, to become
a desert, become impassable or unfrequented, to be
blocked up; to be frustrated.

खिल्य, अस्, m., Ved. a piece of waste or uncultivated
land situated between cultivated fields, a desert; a piece
of rock in the earth, a mass, a heap, a lump, &c.
